subject: ♻️ Accommodation Application Replaced - New Reference #$application_id
body:
Dear $student_name,

Your previous accommodation application has been REPLACED with a new one. Only the new application below will be reviewed — the previous one has been withdrawn and no longer counts.

=== YOUR NEW APPLICATION ===
Reference Number: $application_id
Student ID: $student_id
Submitted On: $submission_date
Submitted By: $submitted_by

Preferred Building: $preferred_building
Preferred Room Type: $preferred_room_type
Requested Move-In Date: $move_in_date
Requested Duration: $duration_months months
Estimated End Date: $end_date
Special Requirements: $special_requirements

Current Status: $status

=== APPLICATION(S) THAT WERE REPLACED ===
$superseded_summary

=== IMPORTANT ===
If you did NOT ask for your application to be replaced, contact the Housing Office immediately on housing@university.edu — we can restore the previous application if this was done in error.

Replacing an application does not move you to the back of any queue: your original application date is recorded against this replacement.

=== WHAT HAPPENS NEXT ===
1. Housing Administration will review the new application above.
2. We may contact you if we need more information.
3. You will receive an email with the outcome, including the building, room number and floor number if you are offered a room.

Typical review time is 5-7 working days.

=== CONTACT INFORMATION ===
Housing Office: housing@university.edu
Phone: (555) 123-4567
Office Hours: Monday-Friday, 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM

Best regards,
University Housing Administration

$signature
